additional_info.subject: Recurring fault – SID Y2R0313281750001
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We are once again observing a fault on SID Y2R0313281750001.
For your information, a maintenance operation was carried out less than two weeks ago to resolve this same issue.
Despite this recent intervention, the fault has reappeared.
The supervision platform currently shows an in fault status with a vendor-specific error related to the DoorPositionSwitch, making the connector unavailable.
Please let us know:
the likely root cause of this recurring issue,
the corrective actions planned,
and whether an on-site intervention is required in the short term.
This malfunction is directly impacting equipment availability.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
.
